svg.title: Mobility uses a transport-weighted time rather than a particle average
svg.desc: Normalized Maxwell-Boltzmann particle and transport energy densities are sqrt(y)exp(-y)/Gamma(3/2) and y^(3/2)exp(-y)/Gamma(5/2), where y=K/(kBT); each integrates to one over zero to infinity. For tau(K)=0.670864 ps sqrt(50 meV/K) at 300 K, the transport average is approximately 0.702 ps and the particle average 1.053 ps, a ratio 1.5.
